settings.lyricsPriorityDesc: Controls the order sources are tried automatically, e.g. {example}. Lowercase letters and single "/" separators only. Leave blank to use the default order. Manual source selection in the lyrics panel is unaffected.
settings.lyricsPriorityInvalidFormat: Invalid format — lowercase letters and single "/" separators only, e.g. {example}. Unknown tokens are also rejected.
settings.lyricsDeleteDesc: Permanently delete every cached lyrics file for a given source, across your whole library. Type a source token (e.g. {apple}, {imported}, or {all} for everything).
settings.lyricsDeleteButtonTitle: Delete all cached lyrics for this source
settings.lyricsDeleteAllConfirm: Delete ALL cached lyrics — every source, including imported files — for every track in your library? This cannot be undone.
settings.lyricsDeleteTokenConfirm: Delete all "{label}" lyrics for every track in your library? This cannot be undone.
settings.lyricsDeleteNoneFound: No cached {label} lyrics found to delete
settings.artistsSubtitle: Configure how multi-artist tags are split and how album artist is determined
settings.artistSplitRulesDesc: Delimiters used to split a raw artist tag into individual artists, tried in order (top = highest priority). Escape a delimiter with a backslash (e.g. "Simon \& Garfunkel") to keep it as one artist.
settings.artistSplitRulesEmpty: No delimiters configured — artist tags will not be split.
settings.artistSplitRulesAddPlaceholder: Add a delimiter, e.g. feat. or /
settings.albumArtistModeDesc: How each album's displayed artist is chosen when scanning
settings.albumArtistFirstTrackDesc: Ignores the Album Artist tag entirely and always uses whichever track's artist was scanned first (current/default behavior).
settings.albumArtistTagDesc: Uses each file's Album Artist tag when present, falling back to the first track's artist otherwise.
settings.rescanRequired: Rescan your library to apply these changes
